title: nightlight stats/<repo>.json and stats/<repo>-history.jsonl
description: Local, gitignored cost/time reference for one target repo -- see README.md's stats.sh section. Written only by overnight.sh's update_stats() and record_session_totals(). There is no schema validator dependency in this repo (nightlight has none at all, by design); overnight.sh's validate_stats_shape() is a small hand-written jq structural check kept manually in sync with this file, not a generated one -- if you add or rename a field here, update that function too.

sessions.description: Lifetime count of individual `claude -p` dispatches (each task, plus housekeeping) -- not runs of overnight.sh.

total_cache_read_tokens.description: Absent on files predating cache-token tracking (task #2); always present on anything written by the current code.

lastSession.description: The most recently completed overnight.sh invocation for this repo -- overwritten every run. stats/<repo>-history.jsonl holds one of these per run, append-only, for anything wanting a real time series.

repo.description: Only present in stats/<repo>-history.jsonl entries, not lastSession -- makes a line self-describing if ever concatenated across repos.

ranAt.description: Only present in stats/<repo>-history.jsonl entries -- date alone doesn't disambiguate multiple runs on the same day.

calls.description: Every dispatch made by this run_repo() invocation: every attempted task plus housekeeping.

tasks.description: One entry per dispatched task this run, in dispatch order. Housekeeping is never included here -- it isn't a numbered task. Empty on runs predating this field (see README) and on --override-prompt runs.

status.description: done/blocked/needs-human come from the task's own TASK_RESULT line; unknown means it never emitted a valid one; dispatch-error means claude itself exited non-zero (see overnight.sh's two-consecutive-failures abort path).
